_comment: Files that call a tool through ctx.call or use with a computed name. Each runs as a module caller, so the callee's reach must allow modules; the owner reviews and lowers the count or documents it. test/reach-module-calls.test.js fails on a new one.

core/about/index.js.note: computed tool name: reviewed by the owner against the callee's reach (pending)

core/agents/index.js.note: reviewed (sessions, 1 Oct): use() calls threads.launch, send, list, usage, history, stop, none asked or person; all reach anyone or modules

core/approvals/index.js.note: reviewed (10 Oct, connect-anything): a forwarder (createItems' call) over the literal tools named in core/approvals/items.js (threads.asks, gate.held, vault.pending and the answering tools); it runs as the approvals module

core/assistant/index.js.note: reviewed by the assistant: every computed call runs as module:assistant and names a read tool of another owner (agents.list, waiting.count and waiting.list, memory.facts and memory.digest, context.now, modules.capabilities, mcp.servers, link.macs, push.devices, team.list, providers.list, threads.list, sessions.prompt.history, undo.list, onboard.status), plus agents.rollover (the one write, whose own code admits module:assistant). Each is dropped when it refuses, so a callee that closes to modules degrades the answer and never errors it.

core/bridges/index.js.note: call() runs as module:bridges and names spaces.membership and spaces.merge-list (modules-only, built) and spaces.policy and spaces.ask (not built yet: a missing tool is tolerated and the share is refused or held)

core/comms/index.js.note: reviewed (10 Oct): the one forwarding wrapper (use) over literal names: mail.send, gate.request, gate.get

core/documents/index.js.note: reviewed (10 Oct): the one forwarding wrapper (use) over literal names: appmods.signing.request, appmods.signed.link, comms.send (all modules or anyone)

core/computer/index.js.note: reviewed (9 Oct): the `ask` helper over literal names, and ctx.call(engine) where engine comes from lib/computer-classes.js engineFor (chrome.*, hands.*, hands-desktop.*, files.*), run for the caller's own agent or a person; each engine checks the caller itself

core/connectors/index.js.note: reviewed (10 Oct): forwarding wrappers over literal tool names (madeConnections' call, the site runner's recordOps, siteEntriesFrom); each runs as the person who asked or the module

core/connectors/site.js.note: reviewed (10 Oct): the one forwarding wrapper (call) the site runner uses; every name it passes is a literal in site.js (memory.site.*, link.macs.call, chrome.op.run)

core/flows/index.js.note: registers the flows.* tools in a loop over a fixed name table (ctx.tool with a computed name); it calls no other tool through ctx.call except watchers.items from the watcher bridge, as the flows module

The move's memory port passes memory.offer, export, import and forget (the memory module's own calls, one per move id) through the second.
